archive.append_only: capture directories never rewritten, renamed or deleted; runner refuses unless the committed index is a prefix of the new index
archive.code_changes: only via CAND activation or an append-only T5 amendment; earlier captures keep outputs and recorded commit
archive.election_draws_centipp: uint16 (4000, 9), columns M,L,C,KD,S,V,MP,SD,REST, rint(share_pp*100) clipped to [0,10000]
archive.failures: retry only within the week with the same anchor and code; arms still failing are committed as FAILED; nothing recomputed after commit

files.<arm>.npz (T2 arms, C0p): poll_quantiles float32 (5, 99, 8): horizons x levels 0.01..0.99 x M,L,C,KD,S,V,MP,SD, numpy.quantile method linear; T2 arms also election_draws_centipp
files.diagnostics.json: v0.3 reading at O, Omega_O + centre count (>= 30 required, as T2), k per U arm + error count, theta, Uc counts + h' fallback, D0/C0p fallback use, h_E
files.manifest.json: capture identity, anchor, input hashes, per-arm status/N/seeds/file sha256/labels, preregistration hashes and T5 amendments, all file hashes

archive.index: data/processed/shadow_2030/index.json: append-only, entries {capture_date, iso_week, path, manifest_sha256, arms, code_commit, previous_entry_sha256}, plus missed_weeks
archive.missed_weeks: no backfill; a week without a committed capture stays missing; the next capture appends skipped ISO weeks to missed_weeks
archive.npz_encoding: ZIP_DEFLATED, fixed member timestamps, no pickle (as exact_draw_sidecar._npz_bytes)
archive.retention: permanent; C0 relies on production sidecar retention (benchmark amendment 007)
verification: file hashes vs manifest; manifest vs index; index chain
first commit containing the manifest within the ISO week, after the anchor's first archive commit, reachable from shadow/2030; committer times are self-reported while the branch is local only
anchor present with recorded hashes; polls CSV at anchor commit matches the snapshot hash
C0 sidecar passes load_verified_draw_sidecar unless C0_RECOMPUTED
code commit exists and is an ancestor of shadow/2030
replay diagnostic only (not bit-stable across runtimes)

election_day.fallback: C0_RECOMPUTED at the anchor source_git_commit and snapshot, seed 12345, 100000 draws, retained in the shadow archive; never claimed equal to the certified forecast
election_day.source: anchor generation's verified exact-draw sidecar, referenced not copied
election_day.verification: scripts.simulator.exact_draw_sidecar.load_verified_draw_sidecar + first archive commit before run start

C0.model_version_changes: production as published; model_version recorded per capture; reports split by production model version; no pinned-1.2.0-rc1 arm unless an amendment adds it
C0.noise_pool_note: production 2030 pool K=6 (2002-2022) while T2 arms, FB and CAND use K=7, by design: C0 is production as published

poll_targets.code: production model files at the anchor source_git_commit; detached temporary worktree if they differ from the T5 code commit
poll_targets.definition: production OpinionState v1.1 on the v0.2 reading at O (v0.2 files at the anchor source_git_commit) + production symmetric CLR bootstrap at min(h,112) with production fallback + common term N(0, Omega_O) with shared normals

production_archive.contents: snapshot.json (marginal histograms, summary quantiles, input hashes) + exact-draw sidecar draws.npz (vote_shares_pct 100000x9 float64, seats 100000x8) + draws.json
production_archive.forecast_target: election day only; no poll-average distributions
production_archive.retention: 2026 benchmark amendment 007: every newly certified generation, without end

T2_arms.aggregate: v0.3 = T1 SH filter (2026 segment hyperparameters in diagnostics/calibration_2030/t1_results.json) + rolling weights W

election_day.construction: arm state + dynamics to h_E, REST = 100 - eight shares, interim noise law via apply_batch_simplex_transfer(eps=0.01 pp)
election_day.noise_law: amendment 001: Gaussian beta=0.5, gamma=0, refit on seven corrected residuals 2002-2026

T2_arms.election_day_shock_interval: open interval (O, D) for every target, as the final round; an election on the target date gets no shock; no 2030 shock in the 2030 election-day distribution
T2_arms.fitted_per_capture: k per U arm, theta, Omega_O, Uc transitions, D0 fallback: recomputed every capture by the final round's causal procedures at origin O on the capture snapshot; k over T2's 14-day grid from 2010-10-03 continued past 2026-11-18; per-origin caching only if byte-identical recomputation on the same pinned snapshot; about an hour a week, accepted

poll_targets.construction: T2: arm state at O + arm dynamics O->D + common poll-average term N(0, Omega_O)

T2_arms.uc_off_grid: bootstrap at the exact horizon; fewer-than-30 fallback steps down T2's grid [7,28,91,182,365,730,1095,1460]

arms.fixed: arms never removed; only CAND is added later; any other addition needs an append-only T5 amendment and is never backfilled

CAND.definition: T4 CAND as configured at the commit recording T4 results; noise = T3-rev selection refit on 2002-2026
CAND.label: T4 verdict: T4_PASS or T4_FAIL, plus 2026 flag
CAND.logged_from: first capture with origin on or after the UTC date of the commit first adding T4's results record
CAND.t4_completion: UTC date of the commit first adding the T4 results record named in the final-round preregistration (default diagnostics/calibration_2030/t4_results.json)

FB.definition: F1 + v0.3 + interim noise (Gaussian beta=0.5, gamma=0) + production OpinionState and dynamics (112-day cap), T4 candidate path
FB.t4_verdict_record: data/processed/shadow_2030/activations/fb_t4_verdict.json (only if FB is run through T4)

full_pipeline.cand_equals_fb: both still logged under their own names; shared engine seed makes draws byte-identical, checked by verify
full_pipeline.fb_d0_check: FB's election-day distribution equals D0's model (same state, dynamics, noise law); pipeline cross-check, reported only, not independent evidence
full_pipeline.poll_targets_note: a full-pipeline arm's poll-target distribution equals its T2 state-and-dynamics arm (D0 for FB; the T2 selection for CAND), already logged

binding_rule_one_round_budget: the final round is the last retrospective design round on 2010-2026 data for the 2030 model; afterwards a 2030-cycle model change may be justified only by T5 prospective evidence under a new preregistration that cites it
binding_rule_outside_scope: refits by frozen procedures after a new certified election result
body_hash_scope: bytes strictly before the last '<!-- FREEZE-BLOCK-START -->' marker

cadence.anchor: production's first run on or after Monday 00:00 UTC: first certified production generation targeting 2030-09-08 with generated_at_utc >= Monday 00:00 UTC, first committed on origin/main before the run starts
cadence.causality: only polls with Observation.available <= O and results available by O
cadence.no_anchor: week missed; no backfill; no independent acquisition
cadence.origin: anchor as_of; names the capture directory
cadence.polling_snapshot: swedishpolls_individual_polls.csv and raw SwedishPolls files at the anchor source_git_commit; CSV sha256 must equal anchor hashes.poll_data_sha256
cadence.run_window: any time in the ISO week except 18:30-22:00 UTC; committed on shadow/2030 before the week ends, else missed
cadence.unit: ISO week, Monday 00:00:00 UTC to next Monday 00:00:00 UTC

decided_by: user (plan approval 2026-11-18); open items resolved by the lead

decision_rule.counting: captures whose h=91 target exists (>= 3 polls) and has been scored; comparison pools all closed h >= 91 targets
decision_rule.earliest: about 2027-09-06 if the first capture is 2026-11-23
decision_rule.gates: not fixed by T5; set by the later preregistration, which must state them before seeing any T5 comparison beyond the quarterly reports
requires: new preregistration citing T5, frozen before scoring what it decides on
at least 26 weekly captures with closed targets at h >= 91 days

draws_and_seeds.draws_scope: every arm and target, including the FB and CAND election-day pipelines; C0 uses production's archived 100000
draws_and_seeds.t2_arms_and_C0p: int(sha256('calibration-2030:T5:<O>:<target>')[:8], 16), target in h30,h91,h182,h365,h730,election; one default_rng per (capture,target) in T2's draw order, shared across arms; election target then draws Z_noise (N x 9)

operations.branch: dedicated branch shadow/2030, local only for now, never rewritten; runner refuses to write unless shadow/2030 is checked out and never writes to main
operations.isolation: never takes election-simulator-production or election-simulator-render concurrency groups or any benchmark lock; never invokes publication, certification, rendering or deployment; writes only data/processed/shadow_2030/; reads production files as Git objects or from a fresh clone
operations.push_and_ci: pushing shadow/2030 and CI scheduling are separate user decisions; no .github/workflows file added or changed

preconditions: runner committed with T2 arms, C0p and the FB engine path (C0 self-check)

resolved_items.resolution: stand-in replacements, new data, refits by frozen procedures after a new election result and correctness amendments (like F1) are outside rule 1
no Omega term in the election-day distribution
open interval (O, D) everywhere, as the final round; no shock for an election on the target date
recomputed every capture by the final round's causal procedures; per-origin caching only if byte-identical on the same pinned snapshot; about an hour a week accepted
production as published; reports split by production model version
production's first run on or after Monday 00:00 UTC
N=4000 for every arm incl. FB and CAND election-day pipelines; C0 uses its archived 100000
14 days after the window closes, then frozen
accepted; an approximation applied identically to every arm
count captures whose 91-day target has been scored; margins and gates set by the later preregistration, stated before any T5 comparison beyond the quarterly reports
dedicated local-only branch shadow/2030; runner refuses to write to main; pushing and CI are separate user decisions

scoring.aggregation: per horizon; pooled over closed targets with h >= 91
scoring.crps_from_draws: scripts/pollofpolls/backtest_metrics.py::calculate_crps, as T2 (election day; C0 from 100000 sidecar rows)
scoring.crps_from_quantiles: (2/99) * sum over tau=0.01..0.99 of (1{y<q_tau} - tau)(q_tau - y); an approximation (tails beyond 1% and 99% truncated) applied identically to every arm; arms compared within T5 only
scoring.election_day: after the certified 2030 result is committed; truth = certified national shares of the eight parties (pp)
scoring.joint_metrics: reported only unless named by a later preregistration before it is seen
scoring.poll_target: T2's: fieldwork midpoint in [D-7, D+7], effective-sample-weighted (Observation.sample_size) mean of raw eight-party shares, >= 3 polls
scoring.poll_target_closure: scored 14 days after the window closes: closed when D+7+14 days <= scoring snapshot date; value computed once, recorded with the snapshot hash, then frozen
scoring.primary_metric: CRPS per party (pp) averaged over eight parties per (capture, target), as T2

reports.frequency: at most one per calendar quarter
reports.rule: reports never change arms, horizons, targets, metrics, cadence or captures

scoring.secondary: central 50% [q0.25,q0.75] and 90% [q0.05,q0.95] coverage per party, inclusive bounds as calculate_interval_metrics (T2)
